changelog.note: kiszervezés a Python-konstansokból (ROADMAP §1 konfig mint adat); tartalom változatlan; a régi 11 osztály verbatim kulcsokkal, 2. körös határszabályok

regiszter-séma v2: description -> what + not_for (a NOT-szabályok külön mezőben, testvér-szándékokra mutatva), few_shot -> examples (verbatim, változatlan), parent (payment_documents, automated_notices, broadcast, human_correspondence, community_events, other); egy általános bővítés: a szolgáltató saját ügyfeleinek szóló csomag-/terv-ajánlata newsletter_marketing (in-sample: live_22)

127 (5th group, round B): own data replaced (069 decision): two examples (system_notification, social_network_notification) no longer carry the user's name or user name. Only `examples` changed; GPT sees `what` and `not_for` only, so its instructions are unchanged. New cache keys for the JEV intent question: the email baseline is re-measured on the JEV side.

parents.automated_notices: Automated platform, service, order and social notices.
parents.broadcast: Mass mailings: newsletters, marketing, job alerts.

intents.what: The sender DELIVERS an INVOICE or a PAYMENT REQUEST (számla, e-számla, díjbekérő, faktura, proforma) FOR PAYMENT - the payable document itself is the subject of the message, whether a person or an automated system delivers it. The PURPOSE decides, not the attached document type. Includes an attached e-invoice that states it is already settled / needs no payment, when the invoice itself is the subject of the message (the accounting document is being delivered). Includes a PERSON forwarding (Fw:) an invoice with a short note so it gets paid or booked.
intents.not_for: A bare 'your invoice has arrived, click to view' notification without the document (system_notification). A payment reminder. A message whose subject is another document (certificate, medical or official sheet) with an invoice merely attached alongside (system_notification). Proof of a payment that already happened (fizetesi_visszaigazolas).

intents.what: Confirmation of a payment or refund that has ALREADY HAPPENED: receipt, acknowledgement, 'Receipt for your payment', 'Sikeres fizetés', 'Payment confirmation', credit note (jóváírás), refund. Proof AFTER the money moved, typically automated.
intents.not_for: An invoice still waiting to be paid (szamlakuldes). An open 'check your payment status' notice (system_notification). A parcel or order status update (megrendeles_statusz_ertesites).

intents.what: Information about a CONCRETE school / educational / community EVENT: the date, venue, programme or preparation details of a specific occasion (parents' meeting, lecture, competition, trip, community programme), a non-business notice to parents, students or community members. Includes a social occasion of a club or federation: gala, banquet, awards ceremony, season-closing party (even from a sports organisation).
intents.not_for: A message without a concrete event - this is not a catch-all. Playing in, supporting or organising the SPORTS competition itself (sportesemeny_tamogatas). Mass promotion, discount, coupon or newsletter (newsletter_marketing).

intents.what: Notification about the status change of a CUSTOMER ORDER: the message carries an order id and a status step such as 'Csomag elküldve' (parcel sent), 'Csomagolás alatt' (being packed), delivered, ready for pickup. Includes the order confirmation itself (with an order id).
intents.not_for: A general system or service signal without a concrete purchase order (system_notification). The invoice for the order delivered for payment (szamlakuldes). Proof of the payment itself (fizetesi_visszaigazolas).

intents.what: Messages about the SPORTING activity itself - taking part in or supporting a competition, match or tournament: encouragement and cheering, intention to play, team line-up and travel logistics, match sheets, competition calendars, sports-day announcements.
intents.not_for: A club's or federation's administrative correspondence between people: general-meeting minutes, budget, official letters (business_correspondence). An invitation to a social occasion such as a gala, banquet or awards ceremony (esemeny_tajekoztatas).
examples: II. Magyar Curling Napja és további események

intents.what: Mass newsletter, advertising or marketing message, promotion, coupon or offer - a broadcast bulletin or advertisement, not a personalised transaction. Signals: 'hírlevél' (e.g. Júniusi hírlevél, Zwack Export NEWS, CIB befektetési hírlevél), discount / sale, referral programme, news digest, a periodic editorial issue or weekly review of a platform, shop or magazine ('View this issue', 'szemle', 'heti összefoglaló'), a provider's promotional offer of a new plan or package to its customers; often with an unsubscribe link. The sender is a brand or publication, not a person.
intents.not_for: A platform's automated notice about the recipient's OWN account, service state or a system event (system_notification). An advertised open position (job_posting). A personalised order or payment message (megrendeles_statusz_ertesites / fizetesi_visszaigazolas).
examples: Spórolj és nyerd vissza vásárlásod árát!

intents.what: Automated system or service notification with no personal sender: CI / build result (e.g. GitHub 'Run failed'), service incident or status (statuspage.io), platform product notice (Atlassian / Jira), account or service state (domain renewal, balance), terms-of-service or privacy-policy change notices. Includes automated, no-action-needed DOCUMENT delivery for information: insurance policy (kötvény) or its lifecycle notice, bank statement delivery, official or authority notice, re-sent or corrected certificate, a medical or vaccination certificate / treatment sheet - also when an invoice is attached ALONGSIDE it as a secondary item, because the certificate is the subject.
intents.not_for: A concrete purchase order's parcel status (megrendeles_statusz_ertesites). A message whose subject IS the invoice or e-invoice, even one already paid (szamlakuldes). Proof of a completed payment (fizetesi_visszaigazolas). A periodic editorial issue / digest or a promotional offer of a platform, shop or magazine (newsletter_marketing). A social network's connection / activity notice (social_network_notification).
examples: Claude Incident - Elevated errors on Opus 4.8
Your organization now has Goals, Projects, and more

intents.what: Job offer / recruiting notice: 'X is hiring …', 'N new job offer(s) matching your criteria', 'Senior Project Manager: … hired roles', a job advertisement or a job-portal / LinkedIn job alert - an ADVERTISED open position.
intents.not_for: One's own work correspondence (business_correspondence). A social network's connection or activity notice without a job (social_network_notification). A general newsletter (newsletter_marketing).
examples: MOL Magyarország is hiring a Senior IT Project Manager
2 new job offer(s) matching your criteria: project manager
Senior Project Manager: MOL Group and bp hired roles

intents.what: Genuine business / project correspondence between PEOPLE: aligning project plans, reference letter, meeting follow-up, technical or business coordination (e.g. NPRA technical assistance, Cyprus SIS follow-up, reporting database) - a concrete work thread, often with Re: / Fw: in the subject. Includes procurement / tender / request-for-quote threads; a real person sending a contract for review or signature, sending a report, arranging a project or meeting, or forwarding an insurance / travel matter for action - even when a document is attached; a club's or federation's administrative correspondence (minutes, budget, official letters).
intents.not_for: An automated system notice (system_notification). A newsletter (newsletter_marketing). An advertised job (job_posting). A forwarded invoice with only a short delivery note (szamlakuldes). The details of a concrete community event (esemeny_tajekoztatas).
examples: RE: Updated programme plan for NPRA technical assistance
Fw: ERM app for CY SIS
Optimization of the Reporting Database for Returns

intents.what: AUTOMATED notification of a social / professional network (e.g. LinkedIn): connection suggestion ('Attila, add X'), accepted connection ('X accepted your request'), search appearances ('You appeared in N searches this week'), weekly activity report. Platform-generated noise.
intents.not_for: A personal message from a person (business_correspondence). A job offer or job alert (job_posting). A platform's service / account notice outside the social feed (system_notification).
examples: You appeared in 14 searches this week

intents.what: Anything else that fits none of the intents above (photos, calendar items, personal chatter, unclear or empty messages).
intents.not_for: Anything that fits a listed intent even loosely.
